title: FiduciaTasks
description: Durable task payloads: a claimable unit of work whose exclusive owner holds a fencing token. Progress/complete/fail must present that token, so a stale worker cannot commit newer state.

TaskCreateRequest.title: TaskCreateRequest
TaskCreateRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/tasks/create. Idempotent: a repeat create returns the existing task.

name.description: Slash-safe task name, such as repo/acme/api/issue/482.

task_type.description: Application task kind, such as implement or backup.

payload.description: Small task input. Large inputs belong in the application database; store a reference here.

deadline_ms.description: Overall deadline in ms since epoch.

TaskClaimRequest.title: TaskClaimRequest
TaskClaimRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/tasks/claim. Grants a fresh fencing token and an ownership lease if the task is pending or its prior lease expired.

ttl_ms.description: Ownership lease length in ms. Defaults to 60000.

TaskProgressRequest.title: TaskProgressRequest
TaskProgressRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/tasks/progress. Renews the lease; rejected unless the caller holds the current fencing token.

TaskCompleteRequest.title: TaskCompleteRequest
TaskCompleteRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/tasks/complete. Requires the current fencing token.

TaskFailRequest.title: TaskFailRequest
TaskFailRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/tasks/fail. retryable returns the task to Pending for reassignment; otherwise it ends Failed. Requires the current fencing token.

retryable.description: Whether to requeue for another worker.

TaskState.title: TaskState
TaskState.description: Current task state returned by GET /v1/tasks.

fencing_token.description: Monotonic token of the current claim (0 if never claimed).

lease_expires_ms.description: When the current ownership lease expires.

generation.description: Monotonic state version, bumped on every mutation.
